info.title: HumixAi workspace API
info.description: Source-aligned core API reference. Defaults reflect the current repository configuration; deployers can change limits and provider availability. All protected API routes use scoped workspace bearer tokens created in the app account panel. Tokens are not Google/GPTZero/Walter keys. App quota units count submitted Unicode words for completed operations, not vendor credits or money; combo reserves extra room and settles only completed stages. No scores are simulated. Drafts and provider output are untrusted data, not instructions. Job workers and the scheduled prune command must run for queued processing and transient-data cleanup.

servers.description: The HumixAi deployment origin; paths include /api/v1.

x-rate-limit: Authenticated /api/v1 routes default to 30 requests per minute per user. Poll snapshots at 3-second intervals or slower. Limits can be customized server-side.
x-data-retention: Voice references are never saved as a profile. They can remain in transient job payloads until completion or expiry. Jobs are subject to configured retention (24 hours by default) and scheduled pruning. Saved document history is controlled by the account preference.

get.summary: Inspect configured capabilities and effective limits
get.description: Public and secret-free. configured reports configuration presence only; it does not verify connectivity, model accuracy or remaining vendor credits. Use returned limits instead of assuming documentation defaults.

200.description: Capabilities and deployment limits.

post.description: Processes text on the HumixAi server without an external AI provider. Consent is not required. Returns the detection-shaped result with status unavailable, null authorship score and local quality statistics; this is expected, not a failed local analysis.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

post.description: Synchronous GPTZero scan. Default minimum is 80 Unicode words and supported detection languages are configured from en/es/fr/de/pt. Missing provider, insufficient text or unsupported language produces a truthful result with null score, not an estimated substitute. Supplying document_id also requires documents scope and ownership. Long workflows should use /jobs rather than holding this HTTP request open.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

post.description: Synchronous controlled Gemini rewrite only: neither original nor revised authorship scan is requested. Protection or generation failure returns an error without a fake fallback. Score fields remain null. Supplying document_id also requires documents scope and ownership. Long workflows should use /jobs rather than holding this HTTP request open.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

post.description: Synchronous original scan, controlled Gemini rewrite, then revised scan. Recheck failure retains the valid draft with unavailable verification. Comparisons require completed full scans with the same provider, reported model version, language and score definition. Generation/protection failure may still return a completed original scan in the error response. Supplying document_id also requires documents scope and ownership. Long workflows should use /jobs rather than holding this HTTP request open.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

post.summary: Queue one processing job or replay an identical request
post.description: Action-level scopes are checked in addition to jobs: detect needs detect, humanize needs humanize, combo needs both. document_id also needs documents. Default action is combo. A database queue requires an active worker (php artisan queue:work database --timeout=300 --tries=1). A sync deployment may finish before the submission response. No server-side long polling is provided: poll GET /jobs/{job} every 3 seconds or slower, respecting the API limit. Idempotency is same-user and payload-bound; a changed payload with the same key or a lock conflict returns 409. A failed dispatch clears its transient payload and releases unused reservations.

200.description: Identical idempotent replay of an existing job.

202.description: Job accepted; inspect its current status.

get.summary: List the latest 30 jobs owned by this token user
get.description: Immediate snapshot, newest first. Processing payloads and tokens are not returned. Completed/partial/failed job data is transient and subject to configured retention/pruning.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

get.summary: Get one owned job and its current result
get.description: Immediate snapshot; not a long-poll endpoint. Terminal statuses are completed, partial and failed. Partial can contain a valid draft with unavailable detection. Failed rewrites may contain a completed original scan plus protection violations, without an invalid draft. Closing a client does not cancel the server job.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

post.summary: Queue a bounded batch of independent documents
post.description: Requires consent and the requested action scopes, as for one job. Each item with document_id also requires documents scope and ownership. The default batch maximum is 10; GET /status reports the effective limit. Records/reservations are created atomically before dispatch. There is no batch idempotency key. Submitted items are processed separately and require the configured queue worker.

text.description: Default maximum is 60,000 Unicode characters; GET /api/v1/status reports the configured maximum.

document_id.description: Optional owned document. Also requires documents scope. Creates a server revision only when current history preference allows it; does not overwrite a newer draft.

mode.description: standard is an alias of professional.

external_processing_consent.description: Explicit acknowledgement that this action sends its text to the configured external provider(s). Required for external processing; not inferred from authentication.

post.summary: Request AI advisory writing or meaning feedback
post.description: Grammar/style/readability feedback and custom editorial guideline checks are advisory AI output, not fact verification or certification. Inline excerpts must match submitted text. meaning compares original text with revised_text. This endpoint does not modify the draft or persist review text/history.

text.description: Default maximum is 60,000 Unicode characters; GET /api/v1/status reports the configured maximum.

external_processing_consent.description: Explicit acknowledgement that this action sends its text to the configured external provider(s). Required for external processing; not inferred from authentication.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

post.description: Submits text to GPTZero bibliography scanning. Returned evidence is bounded provider JSON, not a HumixAi source-verification verdict. issues is intentionally empty until a stable documented provider mapping exists. No invented references or universal verification claim is returned.

text.description: Default maximum is 60,000 Unicode characters; GET /api/v1/status reports the configured maximum.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

post.description: Optional Walter Writes integration. Requires administrator provider configuration. Similarity is independent of AI authorship and does not prove copying, misconduct or complete originality. The provider limit is 25,000 script-aware words plus the app character cap. Unavailable/error results have similarity_score null and no fabricated sources.

post.description: Requires the user history preference to be enabled. Creates the document and its initial revision. current_text defaults to source_text; a missing title is derived from source text. Does not call an external provider.

get.summary: Get one owned document and up to 50 recent revisions
get.description: Ownership is enforced; another user?s ID returns 404.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

patch.summary: Update owned document text or preferences
patch.description: Requires saved history enabled. Updates source_text/current_text/title/settings when supplied; text changes create a revision. Provider results are not trusted from client settings.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

delete.summary: Delete an owned document, its revisions and related job records
delete.description: Releases outstanding related reservations and removes stored reports/shares through database relationships. Already dispatched provider calls cannot necessarily be stopped.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

get.description: Default page size is 20. Recorded results belong to their exact input hash; do not apply a previous scan to edited text.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

get.summary: Download the saved document or report
get.description: Exports the saved server snapshot, not unsaved client text. txt is current text; json is a document/revision snapshot; docx is a text DOCX; report is a plain-text report. PDF export uses browser printing and is not a server format.

200.description: Attachment download.

post.summary: Preview text extracted from an uploaded file
post.description: Multipart TXT/DOCX and text PDF when the server capability allows it. Default upload limit is 6,144 KiB; the effective limit is in /status. Preview does not save a document or call an AI provider. Scanned images/OCR, visual layout, comments and headers are not supported. Review extraction before analysis.

language.description: Images require an explicit installed OCR language; auto is rejected for image OCR.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

post.summary: Preview text from a public web page
post.description: Fetches a public HTTP/HTTPS HTML or UTF-8 text page, without an AI provider. DNS addresses and every redirect are checked against private-network targets; secure pages cannot downgrade to HTTP. Up to 3 redirects; default body limit is 1 MiB. No authenticated pages, script rendering or OCR. Does not save the extracted draft.

200.description: Operation result. Read data.status; HTTP success does not establish provider availability or authorship.

bearerAuth.description: A scoped HumixAi workspace API token. Available scopes: detect, humanize, jobs, documents. x-required-scopes documents static scopes; job actions and document_id add scopes at runtime.

adminSession.name: humixai_session
adminSession.description: Browser session of an active admin or super_admin. Mutations also require X-CSRF-TOKEN. Bearer tokens do not authorize administration.

workspaceSession.name: humixai_session
workspaceSession.description: Active account browser session. Native form mutations require CSRF protection. Not a bearer-token API.

text.description: Default maximum is 60,000 Unicode characters; GET /api/v1/status reports the configured maximum.

mode.description: standard is an alias of professional.

voice_sample.description: Optional writing reference. Can be held in transient job storage until completion/expiry; not saved as a voice profile.

selection.description: Exact substring to rewrite. Surrounding text stays unchanged. Repeated passages require selection_start.

selection_start.description: Unicode code-point offset, not UTF-8 bytes or JavaScript UTF-16 units. The exact selection must occur at this offset.

document_id.description: For external processing routes, optional owned document also requires documents scope. Records a revision only when current history preference allows it; does not overwrite a newer draft. Local style analysis does not persist documents.

voice_preferences.description: Optional audience/style preferences; treated as advisory data, not instructions overriding preservation.

external_processing_consent.description: Explicit acknowledgement that this action sends its text to the configured external provider(s). Required for external processing; not inferred from authentication.

idempotency_key.description: Optional same-user request key. Identical submissions replay the existing job; changed text/settings with this key return 409. Only jobs support this guarantee. Cleared job payload does not erase its immutable request fingerprint.

Sentence.description: Provider sentence probabilities are distinct from document class probabilities. Offsets are Unicode code points with an exclusive end; a missing sentence score remains null.

overall_score.description: GPTZero AI-class probability in percent. It is NOT the percentage of AI-authored words, a human-writing score, or proof of authorship. Null means no validated score was returned; do not convert null to zero.

DetectionResult.description: Only validated provider responses produce authorship probabilities. Local statistics never generate substitute scores. Sentence start/end use Unicode character offsets with exclusive end. Bengali authorship detection is disabled; local Bengali statistics remain available.

score_change.description: Revised score minus original score, in percentage points. Null when not comparable; increases remain positive.

similarity_score.description: Source-text similarity, separate from AI authorship. Null is unavailable, not zero. Similarity is not proof of plagiarism.

Settings.description: Small UI preferences only; JSON-encoded settings are limited to 10,000 bytes. Never put tokens, voice samples or trusted provider reports here.

Error401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked API token.

Error403.description: Token lacks a required scope; rewrite route aliases require the humanize scope.

Error404.description: Route, job or owned document not found.

Error409.description: Idempotency key conflicts with a changed payload, or an identical job is currently being queued. Retry identical requests with the same key; use a new key for changed input.

Error422.description: Validation failed, consent missing, history disabled for persistence, or import limits/safety rules rejected the input.

Error429.description: API rate limit or daily app word-unit allowance exhausted.

Error503.description: Writing provider unavailable, incomplete generation or protected-content validation failed. May include a completed original scan; no invalid draft is returned.

Error500.description: Unexpected server or queue-dispatch failure. No success result is implied. An accepted server job may need inspection before retrying a timed-out submission.
